subject: School District Capital Plan
overview: The MPS Strategic & Capital Planning Subcommittee met to review and finalize recommendations for the district's multi-year capital plan. The committee prioritized urgent FY25 building and security needs, reviewed major HVAC and roof bonding for McGlynn and Andrews, and voted to forward the updated plan to the full School Committee.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews Capital Project Scope and Bonding
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed progress on the McGlynn and Andrews school capital projects, confirming that HVAC, roof rebuilds, mini-splits, and solar will be bundled into a city bonding package.

items.title: Building Recommissioning and MSBA Accelerated Repair Program
items.summary: Members discussed conducting mini-assessments to prepare for the MSBA accelerated repair application window for roof and HVAC needs at Brooks, Roberts, and Missituk.

items.title: District Electrification Assessment
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt outlined technical assistance available through the state Green Communities leadership program to help evaluate school building electrification.

items.title: Prioritization of Immediate Facilities Projects
items.summary: The subcommittee prioritized urgent FY25 projects—including network closet mini-splits, freight elevator controls at Medford High School, and Brooks field drainage—and agreed to seek state grant assistance for entrance plaza ADA compliance.

items.title: Security and Keyless Access Upgrades
items.summary: The subcommittee recommended prioritizing a $260,000 project for keyless fobs, electronic door locks, and integrated camera intercoms across district schools.

items.title: Elementary Playground Priorities and Space Constraints
items.summary: The committee identified Roberts Elementary as the top priority for playground and space solutions due to overcrowding and site limitations, deciding to further explore footprint options before submitting a Community Preservation Act grant application.

items.title: Referral of Capital Plan Recommendations
items.summary: The subcommittee finalized project status designations and voted to forward the updated capital plan recommendations to the full School Committee.
